title: The Confidence Shortcut: A Reasoning Failure Mode of Masked Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.29123v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Chain-of-thought reasoning helps autoregressive models solve complex problems by generating intermediate steps that support later predictions. Masked diffusion models (MDMs) offer a similar opportunity through arbitrary-order generation: they can ideally reveal intermediate results along logical dependencies. In practice, however, standard decoding simply prioritizes high-confidence tokens, which need not align with this dependency order. We identify this discrepancy as the \emph{confidence shortcut}: models commit with high certainty to plausible tokens while neglecting long-range dependencies. In multi-digit addition, models predict higher-order digits without properly tracking carries through long chains. translated_title: 置信度捷径：掩码扩散模型的一种推理失败模式
translated_abstract: 思维链推理通过生成支持后续预测的中间步骤，帮助自回归模型解决复杂问题。掩码扩散模型（MDMs）通过任意顺序的生成提供了类似的机会：理想情况下，它们可以沿着逻辑依赖关系揭示中间结果。然而在实践中，标准解码只是简单地优先处理高置信度的token，而这未必与逻辑依赖顺序一致。我们将这种差异识别为“置信度捷径”：模型以高确定性提交看似合理的token，却忽视了长程依赖关系。在多位数加法中，模型在未能正确跟踪长链进位的情况下就预测了高位数字。跨多种推理任务的控制预训练实验证实，置信度引导的排序往往选择次优序列，而与置信度对齐的训练方案可能会加剧这些失败——例如，增加准……
tldr: 论文揭示了掩码扩散模型中的“置信度捷径”失败模式：标准解码优先选择高置信度token而非遵循逻辑依赖顺序，导致模型在多位数加法等任务中无法正确处理长程依赖，且与置信度对齐的训练方案反而会加剧这一问题。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the "confidence shortcut" failure mode in masked diffusion models, where standard decoding prioritizes high-confidence tokens over logical dependency order, causing failures in long-range dependency tasks such as multi-digit addition, and confidence-aligned training schemes can further exacerbate these failures.
